Method of Attack: A preinstall script in the npm package, which gets executed during installation, collects information about the operating system which is used for decoding relevant encrypted files. After decoding, these files are then used to download a second-stage malicious binary. The attacker used the Havoc Framework for the second stage of the attack.
Impacted Systems: Operating systems used by the targeted bank

Method of Attack: The malicious NPM package lies inactive on the login page of the bank and doesn’t act unless triggered. The payload had a unique Element ID in the HTML of the login page and attached itself to a specific login form element which prevents it from getting detected and collecting login data.
Impacted Systems: Mobile login page of the targeted bank
